commands.enviromine_revived.show: %s: body %s °C (heading for %s, ambient %s °C, heat level %s), hydration %s (thirst level %s)
enviromine_revived.warning.hot.2: You are overheating. Find shade or water
enviromine_revived.configuration.title: EnviroMine Revived
enviromine_revived.configuration.hud.too: Where and how the temperature and hydration display is drawn.
enviromine_revived.configuration.enabled: Show the temperature and hydration HUD.
Where the HUD is drawn. Status bars stacks it above the hunger bar like a vanilla bar.
enviromine_revived.configuration.offset_: Moves the HUD right (positive) or left (negative), in GUI pixels.
Moves the HUD down (positive) or up (negative), in GUI pixels.
enviromine_revived.configuration.show_nu: Show numbers (e.g. 37.2° and 87%) instead of bars.
enviromine_revived.configuration.show_in: Also show the HUD in creative mode (stats do not change there).
enviromine_revived.configuration.feature: Turn whole systems on or off.
enviromine_revived.configuration.tempera: Body temperature (the system, or its settings).
enviromine_revived.configuration.hydrati: Hydration and thirst (the system, or its settings).
enviromine_revived.configuration.effects: Heatstroke, Hypothermia and Dehydration effects, and their damage.
Damage at the most severe levels.
enviromine_revived.configuration.drink_b: Drink by right-clicking water or a cauldron with an empty hand.
enviromine_revived.configuration.thresho: Where warnings, effects and damage start.
enviromine_revived.configuration.water.t: What each kind of water does.
enviromine_revived.configuration.cold.to: Water from snowy biomes and high mountains.
enviromine_revived.configuration.dirty.t: Swamp water and stagnant cave water.
enviromine_revived.configuration.comfort: Body temperature settles at ambient + this. With 12, an ambient of 25 is comfortable.
enviromine_revived.configuration.biome_h: Ambient temperature of the hottest vanilla biomes (biome temperature 2.0).
enviromine_revived.configuration.biome_c: Ambient temperature of the coldest vanilla biomes (biome temperature -2.0).
enviromine_revived.configuration.undergr: Deep underground is pulled towards this ambient temperature (it only ever warms).
Height where the underground effect starts.
Height where the underground effect is complete.
enviromine_revived.configuration.high_al: High places are pulled towards this ambient temperature (it only ever cools).
Height where high-altitude cooling is complete.
enviromine_revived.configuration.rain_co: Cooling while out in the rain.
enviromine_revived.configuration.shade_c: Cooling in the shade during the day.
enviromine_revived.configuration.night_c: Cooling at the coldest part of the night.
enviromine_revived.configuration.arid_ni: Extra night cooling in biomes without rain (deserts get cold at night).
enviromine_revived.configuration.day_cur: Values above 1 make the warmest and coldest parts of the day last longer.
Shifts the warmest point of the day after noon, in degrees of the day cycle.
enviromine_revived.configuration.sleepin: Warmth while sleeping in a bed.
enviromine_revived.configuration.huddle_: Nearby animals warm you if you are colder than their body temperature minus this.
enviromine_revived.configuration.water_c: In water, warmer ambient temperatures are reduced to this...
enviromine_revived.configuration.water_h: ...unless they are this much hotter still, in which case this much is subtracted.
enviromine_revived.configuration.lava_te: Ambient temperature while standing in lava.
enviromine_revived.configuration.burning: Minimum ambient temperature while on fire.
enviromine_revived.configuration.fire_pr: Fire Protection levels (summed over armour) that cancel all heat.
enviromine_revived.configuration.base_ra: Normal speed at which body temperature changes, per update.
enviromine_revived.configuration.exposed: Cooling speed while out in the rain.
enviromine_revived.configuration.strong_: Warming speed near a strong heat source.
A heat source counts as strong when it is this much warmer than the ambient.
enviromine_revived.configuration.drift_a: When body and target differ by more than this, changes speed up proportionally.
enviromine_revived.configuration.base_dr: Hydration lost every update (1.5 s), always.
enviromine_revived.configuration.sweat_b: Body temperature at or above which you sweat.
enviromine_revived.configuration.sweat_d: Extra hydration lost per update while sweating.
enviromine_revived.configuration.sweat_c: Sweating cools the body by this much per update...
...but only while hydration is at least this.
enviromine_revived.configuration.sprint_: Extra hydration lost per update while sprinting.
enviromine_revived.configuration.near_la: Extra hydration lost per update near lava.
enviromine_revived.configuration.arid_da: Extra hydration lost per update in biomes without rain, by day.
enviromine_revived.configuration.hunger_: Extra hydration lost per update with the Hunger effect.
enviromine_revived.configuration.thirst_: Extra hydration lost per update and level of the Thirst effect (salt water).
enviromine_revived.configuration.cold1.t: Body temperature at or below which you are cold (warning).
enviromine_revived.configuration.hot1.to: Body temperature at or above which you are hot (warning).
Hydration at or below which you are thirsty (warning).
enviromine_revived.configuration.sip_hyd: Hydration from a sip of this water.
enviromine_revived.configuration.bottle_: Hydration from a bottle of this water.
enviromine_revived.configuration.cool_on: ...but only while the body is at least this warm.
enviromine_revived.configuration.hunger_: Chance (0 to 1) of the Hunger effect.
enviromine_revived.configuration.poison_: Chance (0 to 1) of the Poison effect.
enviromine_revived.configuration.thirst_: Seconds of the Thirst effect (faster hydration loss). 0 for none.
